title: PolicyGuide: From Guarding One Action to Guiding the Whole Workflow for Policy-Compliant LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.19861v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Customer-service LLM agents must follow organizational policy when acting on a user's behalf. Compliance failures arise from either forbidden actions, such as granting an ineligible change, or omitted procedural requirements, such as identification or confirmation. Runtime safeguards can intervene on risky actions, but action-local checks do not guide an agent through a multi-step procedure. Workflow-following systems support prescribed process execution, but primarily target workflow completion rather than safeguarding agent behavior. PolicyGuide instead compiles each domain policy into a workflow graph and invokes a proactive verifier at user-turn boundaries. From persisted graph state, the verifier reconciles open requests and returns step-specific remediation along a policy-compliant path. translated_title: 政策指南：从守护单一行动到引导政策合规的LLM智能体全流程
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19861v1 公告类型：新 摘要：客户服务型LLM智能体在代表用户行动时必须遵循组织政策。合规失败源于禁止性行动，如授予不符合资格的变更，或遗漏程序性要求，如身份验证或确认。运行时安全措施可以干预风险行动，但行动局部检查无法引导智能体完成多步骤流程。遵循工作流程的系统支持规定的流程执行，但主要目标是完成流程而非保障智能体行为。PolicyGuide 取而代之将每个领域政策编译成工作流图，并在用户轮次边界调用主动验证器。从持久化的图状态出发，验证器协调未决请求，并沿政策合规路径返回步骤特定的修复措施。在 $\tau^2$-bench 的航空、零售和电信领域，使用GPT-5.4智能体和验证器，PolicyGuide 将平均 $\mathrm{Pass}^4$ 从...
tldr: PolicyGuide 通过将政策编译为工作流图并主动验证，在用户轮次边界提供步骤级修复，从而引导LLM智能体全流程合规，显著提升多领域任务通过率。
en_tdlr: PolicyGuide compiles policies into workflow graphs and proactively verifies at user-turn boundaries, providing step-specific remediation to guide LLM agents through full compliant workflows, significantly improving pass rates across domains.
